title: GUSSET-BODY HINGE PILLAR TO WINDSHIELD FRAME LOWER
summary: Convertible (19467) body weld: the steel gussets that tie the door hinge pillar (A-pillar) to the lower corners of the windshield frame, LH and RH, plus the bracket on the hinge pillar for the brake (parking brake) rod. All three are spotwelded; no bolts or torques on this sheet.

parts.name: GUSSET-HINGE PILLAR TO W. SHIELD FRAME LOWER L. H.
parts.name_expanded: Gusset – hinge pillar to windshield frame lower, LH

parts.name: GUSSET-BODY HINGE PILLAR TO W. SHIELD FRAME LOWER R. H.
parts.name_expanded: Gusset – body hinge pillar to windshield frame lower, RH

parts.name: BRACKET ASM-HINGE PILLAR TO BRAKE ROD
parts.name_expanded: Bracket assembly – hinge pillar to brake rod

fastening.note: Spotweld (weld 1A). View B: gusset [1] welded along its lower leg to the hinge pillar.

fastening.to: windshield frame asm lower corner inner LH
fastening.note: Spotweld (weld 1B). View B: upper end of gusset [1] welded to the frame asm.

fastening.to: windshield frame asm lower corner inner RH
fastening.note: Spotweld (weld 2B). View A: welds run along the top flange of gusset [2] into the frame asm.

notes: 1B Spotweld [1] to Frame Asm Lower Corner Inner L. H. 4 places.
2B Spotweld [2] to Frame Asm-Lower Corner Inner R. H. 8 places.
notes_internal: Weld sheet: fastening entries are spotwelds (no fastener items); weld codes 1A/1B etc. from the legend are in the note.
Side of bracket [3] (LH) inferred from View B showing it next to gusset [1], arrow B on the LH corner.
Margin mark 'K39' and stacked triangles at lower left are not part of a torque legend.
